# Request: regenerate the autogenerated Obsidian index on re-render

Affects all versions with `--obsidian` directory rendering (pre-existing;
surfaced by the PR #39 audit).

## Symptom

In-place `--obsidian` with no authored `index.md`: run 1 generates the
wikilink listing at `dir/index.md`; run 2 finds that file, takes the
"authored index" branch, and renders it through the pipeline instead of
regenerating. Notebooks added later never appear in the vault home page:

```
$ rustlab-notebook render A -f markdown --obsidian     # index lists 3 notes
$ touch A/ch2/gamma.md
$ rustlab-notebook render A -f markdown --obsidian     # gamma rendered…
$ grep gamma A/index.md                                 # …but never listed
```

## Proposal

Stamp the generated index with a marker comment
(`<!-- rustlab:generated-index -->`) so a later run can tell "mine" from
"authored": regenerate marked files, keep authored ones untouched. The
`GENERATED_HEADER` already used for rendered notebooks is close but is
also present on rendered *authored* index files, so a distinct marker is
needed.
